product_one_liner.value: Spacelift automates infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and governance for DevOps, platform, and SRE teams using infrastructure as code.
product_one_liner.notes: The about page identifies DevOps, platform, and SRE users and describes infrastructure provisioning, configuration, governance, and integration with IaC tooling: https://spacelift.io/about-us.

pricing_page.notes: A public plans and pricing page exists and describes plans for different stages of growth: https://spacelift.io/pricing.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineer-authored technical posts meet the content test. Adam Connelly, identified as a Spacelift backend engineer, explains worker and launcher architecture in https://spacelift.io/blog/spacelift-workerpool-operator. Joey Stout, identified as a programmer specializing in SRE and DevOps, explains the worker controller, Prometheus exporter, and KEDA autoscaling implementation in https://spacelift.io/blog/autoscaling-native-kubernetes-workers. These are technical infrastructure articles within the company blog rather than a separately branded engineering publication.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple setup articles and extensive product and integration documentation: https://docs.spacelift.io/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable jobs board lists eight openings across sales, marketing, partnerships, people, Kubernetes engineering/product, product operations, and software engineering. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title: https://careers.spacelift.io/jobs.
